parole.testo: Borrowed from Provençal homenatge, from Medieval Latin homināticum (“service of a vassal; homage”), from Latin homō (“man”) ("vassal" in Medieval Latin).

parole.significato: to babble, prattle, blabber, gab, waffle, jabber, rattle, yap
parole.testo: From Provençal parlar (“to speak”) (from Medieval Latin parabolāre) + Spanish derogatory suffix -otear. Compare English palaver.
